name: Nestle S.A.
businessSummary: World's largest food and beverage company: coffee (Nescafe, Nespresso), pet care, nutrition, prepared foods, confectionery, waters. CEO Philipp Navratil. Reports in CHF.

high52w.note: CHF; price 87.72 is slightly above, so the true high is at least the current price.

netDebt.note: CHF m. marketscreener 2026E: 51,143. IFRS 16 lease treatment not stated.

peTrailing.note: Reported (IFRS) EPS basis; halo shows 22.40. Reported EPS depressed by impairments/disposals.

peForward.note: EPS est. 3.827 (2026E), 4.35 (2027E), 4.698 (2028E); 2027E P/E 19.9x. stockanalysis forward 17.74 differs (basis unknown).

netDebtToEbitda.note: Net debt per stockanalysis (lease treatment unstated); stockanalysis itself says about 3.45 (Debt/EBITDA 3.67 gross). Range 3.1-3.5.

organicGrowth9M.note: Q3 4.0%; RIG Q3 2.8% (Q2 1.8%), 9M 1.9%; pricing Q3 1.1%, 9M 1.8%. FY2025 RIG 0.8%. Q3 RIG by zone: Americas 2.4%, AOA 5.0%, Europe 1.0%. 9M sales CHF 65.87bn, flat reported (FX).

tradingMargin.note: EBIT-type (underlying trading operating profit, pre-restructuring/impairment). 2026 guidance: margin to improve vs 16.1%; H2 margin similar to H1 excluding US tariff refunds.

guidance2026.note: Maintained: organic growth 3-4%, RIG accelerating from 0.8%, margin improving vs 16.1%. No change at Q3.

reportedOperatingMargin.source: derived from stockanalysis operating income 13,906 / revenue 89,885
reportedOperatingMargin.note: Reported (IFRS) operating income, includes impairments; vs 16.96% in FY2024.

history.source: stockanalysis.com/quote/swx/NESN/financials (CHF m; ebit = reported operating income; eps = reported EPS, includes disposal gains)

forwardEstimates.source: marketscreener.com 2026E/2027E EPS (basis likely underlying/adjusted, not stated)

recentEvents: Q3/9M 2026 sales (22 Oct): Q3 sales CHF 22.76bn +5.2%, OG 4.0%, RIG 2.8% (accelerating); shares +1.8% to 84.99 on the day.
Early Sept: agreed sale of mainstream vitamins/minerals/supplements to Yellow Wood Partners for USD 1bn.
FY2026 guidance maintained; potential US tariff refunds excluded from H2 margin view.
H1 2026 results mentioned a Peranel joint venture.
valueTrapFlags: FY2025 RIG only 0.8%; 2026 recovery (9M 1.9%) still modest, volume-light growth.
Reported EPS fell from 4.19 (FY2024) to 3.51 (FY2025); payout above 100% on reported EPS.
Net debt/EBITDA about 3.1-3.5 with CHF 56.7bn net debt.
Reported sales flat in CHF for 9M due to FX; stock near 52-week high.
dataGaps: Net debt/EBITDA is derived from mixed sources (range 3.1-3.5)
EPS history is reported not underlying (underlying EPS not retrieved)
FCF history not retrieved; estimate revisions after Q3 not available

valuation.method: Next-12m EPS x justified P/E. Basis 2026E EPS CHF 3.83 (MarketScreener consensus, basis not stated). Reported EPS fell in FY2025. Historical multiple ranges not verified by agents; justified multiples are lead estimates.

bear.note: Volumes stay weak, margin pressure, leverage limits buybacks. Justified multiple 17x on next-12m 3.87.

base.note: Organic growth about 3-4% with gradual margin recovery. Justified multiple 21x on next-12m 4.02.

bull.note: Turnaround restores real internal growth above 3%. Justified multiple 24x on next-12m 4.10.

valuation.whyItFits: Global staples leader with beta 0.5 and a 3.5% dividend; organic growth recovering (Q3 RIG +2.8%).
valuation.growthDrivers: Coffee, pet care, nutrition; cost programme and portfolio pruning.
valuation.saturation: Near its 52-week high after a recovery; forward P/E about 23: no longer cheap.
valuation.principalRisk: Weak volume growth (9M RIG 1.9%) with net debt/EBITDA about 3.2x; consensus unavailable.
